ideas.pitch: A Python tool that automatically pulls curriculum details from SkillInf and generates a 5-slide LinkedIn PDF carousel optimized for high dwell-time engagement.
ideas.problem_statement: Challenge Instructions Create an attractive and original promotional post for SkillInf highlighting its internships, skill development programs, practical learning, and career opportunities.
ideas.title: Interactive Carousel Infographic Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: LinkedIn's algorithm heavily favors document/carousel posts for dwell-time; combining automated data scraping of SkillInf's domain list into clean visual assets directly targets the judging priority of content depth.
